alt: 講者說得生動流暢，想法一個接一個，聽眾專心聽著，幾乎插不上話。
scene_prompt: 口若懸河 means eloquent speech flowing continuously like a river. Modern community storytelling circle. A lively adult storyteller gestures expressively with two normal hands, speaking fluently to three absorbed listeners. A flowing ribbon of small picture-only speech bubbles curves from the speaker across the upper composition, containing successive simple images of mountains, animals and a journey, showing an unbroken stream of ideas, no words or letters. One listener gently raises a finger hoping for a chance to speak but remains attentive. Warm amused mood; NO literal water pouring out of mouth, no spitting or gagging. Keep flowing eloquence focal.
